title: COTRIM-HIGH - Efficacy of daily prophylaxis with Cotrimoxazole 800/160mg on the occurrence of bacterial infections at six months after renal transplantation
official: COTRIM-HIGH - Efficacy of daily prophylaxis with Cotrimoxazole 800/160mg on the occurrence of bacterial infections at six months after renal transplantation
summary: Main objective: To compare the efficacy of a six-month prophylactic treatment by daily high dose cotrimoxazole versus treatment by daily low dose cotrimoxazole in kidney transplant recipients on the occurrence of a bacterial infectious episode between M1 and M6 after transplantation.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient over 18 years of age.
2. Undergoing renal transplantation for the first time
3. Patient having given free and informed consent.
4. Patient affiliated to a Social Security scheme.
5. Patient must be able to understand the nature and purpose of the research, as well as its associated constraints
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient with eGFR below 15mL/min at the time of randomization.
2. Exposure to cotrimoxazole ≥ 14 days, during the last 3 months.
3. Concomitant medications by phenytoin or methotrexate.
4. Hypersensitivity to any of the excipients of listed in Section 6.1 of the Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC)
5. Patient is a relative of the investigator or of any other member of the investigation team whose relationship with the patient is known to the investigator
6. Patient deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision, or subject to a legal protection measure (guardianship or curatorship)
7. Hepatic impairment marked by severe hepatic parenchymal impairment or by alanine aminotransferase levels > 5 times the upper limit of normal.
8. Participation in another clinical trial or interventional study or clinical investigation  or being in the exclusion period at the end of a previous study.
9. Pregnant women and lactation. All women of childbearing potential are required to have a negative serum pregnancy test before treatment and must agree to maintain highly effective contraception by practicing abstinence or by using an effective method of birth control from the date of consent through the end of the study (Hormonal contraception ; Intrauterine device ; Intrauterine hormone-releasing system ; Bilateral tubal occlusion; Vasectomised partner).
10. Prior another solid organ transplant.
11. Combined transplantation i.e. kidney transplantation AND transplantation of another organ.
12. Hypersensitivity or history of allergic reaction to study drug/all sulfamides.
13. History of G6PD deficiency.
14. Known diagnosis of porphyria.
